Beta. Back up your files before you try it, and please report what breaks.

This build was tested without a Blender window, on Blender 5.0 to 5.3. It hasn't been through the test rounds in real Blender yet, so the on-screen slider, the new Movie Mode buttons and real brush strokes are checked by tests of their logic only.

## New

- Movie Mode keeps a camera on the whole model. While Movie Mode is on, Hindsight adds its own camera and places it so every step of the timelapse is in frame. Your own camera isn't moved.
- Lighting when the scene has none: three sun lamps around the model, taken out again with Movie Mode.
- Use this view points the Movie Mode camera from the direction your viewport looks.
- Steps per frame makes a long history a short movie with fewer frames to render.
- Works on Blender 5.2 and 5.3.

## Faster and lighter

- Hindsight's own work per timelapse frame went from 22.6 ms to 2.7 ms at 5,000 steps on a 100k mesh.
- With global history on, the timeline is no longer rebuilt on every redraw.
- Peak memory while saving a 6,000-step history of a 100k mesh went from 89 MB to 43 MB.
- The engine that finds what a stroke changed and applies steps is now written in Rust, for Windows, macOS and Linux, with the Python version as fallback. A 300-step jump takes about half the time.

## Fixed

- The on-screen slider hung to the right of the viewport.
- Crash recovery could bring back a wrong history after the step cap or the memory limit had dropped steps.
- The memory limit could drop steps that an object you had scrubbed back hadn't reached yet.
- Remove Hindsight data from this file failed on Blender 5.2 and 5.3.
- Mask Extract failed on Blender 5.0 and newer, and the Morph History brush was twice the size shown.

The full list is in the changelog.

## Install

1. Download hindsight.zip.
2. In Blender: Edit, Preferences, Get Extensions, Install from Disk.
3. Press N in the 3D viewport and open the Undo History tab.

Report a bug: https://github.com/Min3scon/Hindsight/issues/new/choose
